post.caption:
Stand on Everest and you weigh about 0.3% less, instantly. Gravity weakens with distance from Earth's centre, and Earth bulges at the equator, so you also weigh less in Ecuador than in Norway. Your weight was never a fact about your body. It is a fact about what is underneath you.
